name: praxis-public-web
description: Praxis LS public web — the stranger-facing React 18 + Vite + TS app: the tenant marketing site (/public/*) and the external portal (/portal/*). Standalone app, sibling to client/ and platform-console/.
//why: A third app rather than more routes in client/, because the audience is different and so is the payload: a visitor from a search engine must not download the ERP's shell, its Radix kit, its editor or its fifteen fonts. Same toolchain as client/ and platform-console/ on purpose — one way of building a Vite app in this repo, three surfaces.
//engines: Mirrors the root package.json and .nvmrc, for the reason stated in client/package.json: an undeclared engine range lets a dev tree on a newer Node accept a dependency CI cannot run.
